mqtt.title: MyQ MQTT relay client
mqtt.description: This is only an MQTT client for an already-running device-facing relay. For local MyQ opener control, Home Assistant recommends ratgdo. Use the official myQ app for provider remote control.

cloud.title: Read myQ application configuration
cloud.description: Select the pre-downloaded myQ APK or APKS on the Home Assistant filesystem. Setup reads production OAuth settings locally without executing the app. A runtime attestation token, if required by myQ, cannot be extracted from a static archive.

data.app_check_token: App Check token, optional with BlueberryQDB

callback.title: Complete provider sign-in
callback.description: [Continue with myQ]({auth_url}). Finish sign-in and any verification on the provider page, then paste the complete com.myqops callback URL including code, state and issuer. Use the link from this setup session. If a code expires, select Start a fresh sign-in and submit to generate a new link. Amazon sign-in is available when offered by myQ. Token exchange diagnostic, {token_diagnostic}.

login.title: Sign in to myQ
login.description: Sign in to discover garage doors. If myQ requests a verification code, Home Assistant opens a separate verification step. Your password and verification code are not saved. For Amazon or additional browser checks, select browser sign-in.

data.app_check_token: App Check token, optional with BlueberryQDB

verification.title: myQ verification code
verification.description: Enter the code requested by myQ. This continues the same sign-in session. An incorrect code can be retried here. The session expires after ten minutes of inactivity.

verification_method.title: myQ verification delivery
verification_method.description: Choose a method offered by myQ to receive your verification code.

discover.title: Discover myQ garage doors
discover.description: Sign-in has completed. Retry device discovery without exchanging the authorization code again. If access was revoked, start sign-in again. Token exchange diagnostic, {token_diagnostic}.

credentials.title: Use existing myQ credentials
credentials.description: Enter a refresh token, or an access token and its Unix expiry time. You can copy these fields from your private runtime-auth JSON. Refresh tokens are verified before saving. Connect BlueberryQDB for automatic App Check extraction, or paste an App Check token. During reconfiguration, blank fields retain saved values. A bridge URL takes priority over a pasted App Check token. These credentials are stored in Home Assistant config entry storage.

data.expires_at: Access token expiry as Unix seconds
data.app_check_token: App Check token, optional with BlueberryQDB
data.use_phone_login: Sign in on the connected phone instead

phone_login.title: Sign in on your connected phone
phone_login.description: BlueberryQDB prepares Chrome on the selected phone, then gives you 15 minutes to finish MyQ sign-in and verification. Home Assistant receives the callback automatically. A current App Check token can optionally seed the bridge cache. Leave the connection key blank to retain a discovered or saved key. Current step, {phone_status}. {token_diagnostic}

native.title: Check the signed-in MyQ app connection
native.description: Sign in only inside the official MyQ app on your phone. In the BlueberryQDB panel, use Check connection now, select the actual door control, and save it. Then submit this form to verify the connection immediately. No Chrome login, App Check or OAuth token is needed. Leave the key blank to retain a discovered or saved connection key. Keep the phone unlocked with the door list visible.

error.verification_identity_http_error: myQ rejected the verification request. Start a fresh sign-in and retry the provider prompts.
